transactions.desc: The Athletics optioned Rom to Triple-A Las Vegas on Friday.
The Athletics reinstated Suarez (hip) from the 15-day injured list Friday.
The Cardinals recalled Saggese from Triple-A Memphis on Friday.
The Twins optioned Roden to Triple-A St. Paul on Friday.
The Twins selected Jenkins's contract from Triple-A St. Paul on Friday.
The Rangers recalled Macko from Triple-A Round Rock on Friday.
The Blue Jays recalled Van Eyk from Triple-A Buffalo on Friday.
The Blue Jays designated Woods Richardson for assignment Friday.
The Mets selected Devenski's contract from Triple-A Syracuse on Friday.
The Mets optioned Curry to Triple-A Syracuse on Friday.
The Cubs activated Milner (appendectomy) from the 15-day injured list Friday and designated him for assignment, Mark Feinsand of MLB.com reports.
The Pirates optioned Murdock to Triple-A Indianapolis on Friday.
Pittsburgh recalled Sisk from Triple-A Indianapolis on Friday.
The Reds recalled Arroyo from Triple-A Louisville on Friday.
The White Sox promoted Gilbert from Triple-A Charlotte on Friday.
The White Sox reinstated Benintendi from the bereavement/family medical emergency list Friday.
The Cubs activated Shaw (hand) from the 10-day injured list Friday, Jesse Rogers of ESPN.com reports.
The Rangers optioned Ahlstrom to Triple-A Round Rock on Thursday.
The Cubs optioned Alcantara to Triple-A Iowa on Thursday.
Suarez is back in Triple-A Norfolk on Thursday after signing a minor-league deal with the Orioles, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
The Diamondbacks optioned Jameson to Triple-A Reno following Wednesday's 2-0 win over the Cubs.
The Diamondbacks recalled Cabrera from Triple-A Reno to start Thursday's game against the Giants.
The Giants designated Kennedy for assignment Thursday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Giants reinstated Eldridge from the bereavement list Thursday, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
The Blue Jays optioned Dallas to Triple-A Buffalo on Thursday, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.
The Dodgers recalled Halvorsen from Triple-A Oklahoma City on Thursday.
Lorenzen signed a major-league contract with the Blue Jays on Thursday, Shi Davidi of Sportsnet.ca reports.
The Royals optioned Black to Triple-A Omaha on Thursday.
The Royals selected Gose's contract from Triple-A Omaha on Thursday.
The Royals recalled Rojas from Triple-A Omaha on Thursday.
